inspection_method: local git checkout; inspected README, AUTHORING.md, ordered chapter tree, article/task/solution files, .view examples, and tests

anchors.why: Identifies the repo as English tutorial source, describes enhanced Markdown and translation routing.
Defines root-relative link rules and an info scheme that auto-inserts referenced article titles.
Shows article source under numbered curriculum path.
Shows an atomic exercise with importance metadata and demo reference.
Pairs the task with a separate solution file.
Stores runnable example output beside source material.
Shows test code stored as a lesson/demo sidecar.

known_limits: Enhanced Markdown requires a custom renderer.
Executable examples prove lesson behavior, not evidence support for VAKS claims.
Tutorial content should not be imported wholesale.
